data.name: Carbon 1.5
data.description: Carbon 1.5 is a France-based direct air capture startup said to be developing sorbent-based DAC technology. Independent public information is very limited — no corroborating press, funding announcements, or pilot deployments surfaced in web searches, though the company's website at carbon15.eu is still referenced as active.
